snippet.title: Legends Awaken | BlackScarStudio | #eclipseofeldergaard #steamgame #indiegame
snippet.description:
Eclipse of Eldergaard; A Dark Fantasy Where Time Fights Against You

Step into the crimson world of Eldergaard, where the skies bleed and every second pulls you closer to doom.

You are Ren Huo, the weakest disciple of light, tasked with sealing the Hell Gates before the fallen god Umbra breaks free.

Survive the endless onslaughts, harness the power of sacred crystals, and discover what it truly means to fight against time itself.

🕯️ The world doesn’t need another hero.
It needs someone willing to bleed against fate.

Play / Wishlist Now on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4004760/Eclipse_of_Eldergaard/

Official Website:
🔗 https://blackscarstudio.com

Join the Community (Discord):
👉 https://discord.gg/6gXYgrWzUT

Follow for Updates & Behind the Scenes:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/black_scar_studio

Connect on LinkedIn:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/developer-black-heart 

Game Features:
Fast-paced, time-limited combat against infernal legions.

Explore a world drenched in crimson skies and decaying ruins.

Unlock sacred powers through meditation at crystal shrines.

Two endings, redemption or ruin.
Every moment counts. Every mistake costs time.

Coming Soon, Stay Tuned for More Updates!
#EclipseOfEldergaard #IndieGame #DarkFantasy #SteamGame #ActionAdventure
